{"parentUuid":"87783cd4-2300-4390-abd8-0f114567f0b3","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2c92d053-d6ea-41a1-bf66-d78107b3a5e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Gjj88ys5Vji5HPnhxHYPUv","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/usage_report.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"79bb50dd-0c0b-4a39-a188-333abf9bf526","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:45:28.239Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/usage_report.py","oldString":"    return sum(b - a for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))","newString":"    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Turn notes/usage-ledger.csv into a plan-vs-actual budget report.\n\nUsage:\n    uv run python scripts/usage_report.py                 # summary + forecast\n    uv run python scripts/usage_report.py --remaining 4   # 4 tickets still to do\n\nWhy positive deltas: the 5-hour and weekly meters RESET (drop to 0) when their\nwindow rolls over, and the weekly one only ever climbs inside a week. Summing\nonly the increases between consecutive rows measures what you actually spent\nand ignores the resets. That is what spend() does, and it is your exercise.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nLEDGER = Path(\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\")\n\n\ndef spend(series: list[float | None]) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Total rise across a meter that can reset to a lower value.\n\n    Sum every increase between consecutive readings; ignore blanks (None) and\n    any drop, which means the window reset.\n\n    >>> spend([10.0, 12.0, 15.0])\n    5.0\n    >>> spend([80.0, 5.0, 9.0])\n    4.0\n    >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])\n    3.0\n    \"\"\"\n    return sum(b - a for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))\n\ndef read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:\n        return list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n\ndef to_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:\n    try:\n        return float(text) if text not in (None, \"\") else None\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef by_phase(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:\n    phases: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(\n        lambda: {\"turns\": 0, \"five\": [], \"weekly\": [], \"models\": set(), \"providers\": set()}\n    )\n    for row in rows:\n        phase = phases[row.get(\"phase\") or \"unlabelled\"]\n        phase[\"turns\"] += 1\n        phase[\"five\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"five_h_pct\")))\n        phase[\"weekly\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"weekly_pct\")))\n        if row.get(\"model\"):\n            phase[\"models\"].add(row[\"model\"])\n        if row.get(\"provider\"):\n            phase[\"providers\"].add(row[\"provider\"])\n    return phases\n\n\ndef ticket_phases(phases: dict[str, dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return sorted(p for p in phases if p.upper().startswith(\"T\") and p[1:].isdigit())\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ledger\", type=Path, default=LEDGER)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--remaining\", type=int, default=0, help=\"tickets not yet built\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if not args.ledger.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"No ledger at {args.ledger}. Is the Stop hook registered?\")\n    rows = read_rows(args.ledger)\n    if not rows:\n        raise SystemExit(\"Ledger is empty.\")\n    phases = by_phase(rows)\n\n    print(f\"{'phase':<14}{'turns':>6}{'5h spent':>10}{'weekly':>9}  models / provider\")\n    for name, data in sorted(phases.items()):\n        mix = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"models\"])) or \"?\"\n        prov = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"providers\"] - {\"anthropic\"}))\n        print(f\"{name:<14}{data['turns']:>6}{spend(data['five']):>9.1f}%\"\n              f\"{spend(data['weekly']):>8.1f}%  {mix}{(' @' + prov) if prov else ''}\")\n\n    tickets = ticket_phases(phases)\n    if tickets:\n        per = sum(spend(phases[t][\"weekly\"]) for t in tickets) / len(tickets)\n        print(f\"\\nTickets done: {len(tickets)} · average weekly cost per ticket: {per:.1f}%\")\n        last = next((to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) for r in reversed(rows)\n                     if to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) is not None), None)\n        if last is not None and args.remaining:\n            need, headroom = per * args.remaining, 100 - last\n            verdict = \"FITS\" if need <= headroom * 0.8 else \"TIGHT\" if need <= headroom else \"OVER BUDGET\"\n            print(f\"Forecast: {args.remaining} tickets need ~{need:.0f}% of the weekly cap; \"\n                  f\"{headroom:.0f}% remains → {verdict}\")\n            if verdict != \"FITS\":\n                print(\"Fix in this order: 1) lower effort  2) switch to Sonnet/Haiku  \"\n                      \"3) /clear more often  4) split fat tickets  5) Plan B backend (declare it)\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo ticket phases yet. Write the ticket id into .claude/state/phase \"\n              \"at the start of each /implement session.\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":7,"newStart":33,"newLines":7,"lines":["     >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])","     3.0","     \"\"\"","-    return sum(b - a for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))","+    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))"," "," def read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:","     with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"87783cd4-2300-4390-abd8-0f114567f0b3","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"851df371-63e1-427c-bdbf-38a9f3052ad4","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2c92d053-d6ea-41a1-bf66-d78107b3a5e1","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019n5r7SSZsZQFfX6D5qxbGg","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/usage_report.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"305f6537-963e-41a5-8a89-a04c5c4057bc","timestamp":"2026-10-15T02:45:33.842Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms/scripts/usage_report.py","oldString":"    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))","newString":"    readings = [v for v in series if v is not None]\n    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(readings, readings[1:]))","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Turn notes/usage-ledger.csv into a plan-vs-actual budget report.\n\nUsage:\n    uv run python scripts/usage_report.py                 # summary + forecast\n    uv run python scripts/usage_report.py --remaining 4   # 4 tickets still to do\n\nWhy positive deltas: the 5-hour and weekly meters RESET (drop to 0) when their\nwindow rolls over, and the weekly one only ever climbs inside a week. Summing\nonly the increases between consecutive rows measures what you actually spent\nand ignores the resets. That is what spend() does, and it is your exercise.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport csv\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nLEDGER = Path(\"notes/usage-ledger.csv\")\n\n\ndef spend(series: list[float | None]) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Total rise across a meter that can reset to a lower value.\n\n    Sum every increase between consecutive readings; ignore blanks (None) and\n    any drop, which means the window reset.\n\n    >>> spend([10.0, 12.0, 15.0])\n    5.0\n    >>> spend([80.0, 5.0, 9.0])\n    4.0\n    >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])\n    3.0\n    \"\"\"\n    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))\n\ndef read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:\n    with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:\n        return list(csv.DictReader(f))\n\n\ndef to_float(text: str | None) -> float | None:\n    try:\n        return float(text) if text not in (None, \"\") else None\n    except ValueError:\n        return None\n\n\ndef by_phase(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:\n    phases: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(\n        lambda: {\"turns\": 0, \"five\": [], \"weekly\": [], \"models\": set(), \"providers\": set()}\n    )\n    for row in rows:\n        phase = phases[row.get(\"phase\") or \"unlabelled\"]\n        phase[\"turns\"] += 1\n        phase[\"five\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"five_h_pct\")))\n        phase[\"weekly\"].append(to_float(row.get(\"weekly_pct\")))\n        if row.get(\"model\"):\n            phase[\"models\"].add(row[\"model\"])\n        if row.get(\"provider\"):\n            phase[\"providers\"].add(row[\"provider\"])\n    return phases\n\n\ndef ticket_phases(phases: dict[str, dict]) -> list[str]:\n    return sorted(p for p in phases if p.upper().startswith(\"T\") and p[1:].isdigit())\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    ap.add_argument(\"--ledger\", type=Path, default=LEDGER)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--remaining\", type=int, default=0, help=\"tickets not yet built\")\n    args = ap.parse_args()\n\n    if not args.ledger.exists():\n        raise SystemExit(f\"No ledger at {args.ledger}. Is the Stop hook registered?\")\n    rows = read_rows(args.ledger)\n    if not rows:\n        raise SystemExit(\"Ledger is empty.\")\n    phases = by_phase(rows)\n\n    print(f\"{'phase':<14}{'turns':>6}{'5h spent':>10}{'weekly':>9}  models / provider\")\n    for name, data in sorted(phases.items()):\n        mix = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"models\"])) or \"?\"\n        prov = \",\".join(sorted(data[\"providers\"] - {\"anthropic\"}))\n        print(f\"{name:<14}{data['turns']:>6}{spend(data['five']):>9.1f}%\"\n              f\"{spend(data['weekly']):>8.1f}%  {mix}{(' @' + prov) if prov else ''}\")\n\n    tickets = ticket_phases(phases)\n    if tickets:\n        per = sum(spend(phases[t][\"weekly\"]) for t in tickets) / len(tickets)\n        print(f\"\\nTickets done: {len(tickets)} · average weekly cost per ticket: {per:.1f}%\")\n        last = next((to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) for r in reversed(rows)\n                     if to_float(r.get(\"weekly_pct\")) is not None), None)\n        if last is not None and args.remaining:\n            need, headroom = per * args.remaining, 100 - last\n            verdict = \"FITS\" if need <= headroom * 0.8 else \"TIGHT\" if need <= headroom else \"OVER BUDGET\"\n            print(f\"Forecast: {args.remaining} tickets need ~{need:.0f}% of the weekly cap; \"\n                  f\"{headroom:.0f}% remains → {verdict}\")\n            if verdict != \"FITS\":\n                print(\"Fix in this order: 1) lower effort  2) switch to Sonnet/Haiku  \"\n                      \"3) /clear more often  4) split fat tickets  5) Plan B backend (declare it)\")\n    else:\n        print(\"\\nNo ticket phases yet. Write the ticket id into .claude/state/phase \"\n              \"at the start of each /implement session.\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":7,"newStart":33,"newLines":8,"lines":["     >>> spend([None, 4.0, None, 7.0])","     3.0","     \"\"\"","-    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(series, series[1:]))","+    readings = [v for v in series if v is not None]","+    return sum(max(b - a, 0.0) for a, b in zip(readings, readings[1:]))"," "," def read_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict]:","     with path.open(newline=\"\") as f:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"851df371-63e1-427c-bdbf-38a9f3052ad4","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/refiv/ubuncode/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"4d76fb33-67f7-426c-a6b4-e10410ba73b3","version":"2.1.300","gitBranch":"main"}
